mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window during tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating labor market strength) and low UNRATE (< 4%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion with labor market balance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of 'goldilocks' zone instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO declines and SPX returns remains below 0.1 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth above 5% month-over-month, indicating strong retail sales, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 5-day returns in > 55% of instances with RSAFS growth > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of high FEDFUNDS (> 5%) and low CPIAUCSL growth (< 2% YoY) indicates a controlled inflation environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2.5-year rolling window during balanced monetary policy periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in UNRATE (> 0.5% increase in one month), indicating labor market stress, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce negative 20-day returns in > 50% of instances with UNRATE spikes.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST growth above 10% year-over-year, signaling a strong housing market, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between HOUST growth and SPX returns remains below 0.12 over any 2.5-year window.
